pages.text: Place it $(l)under a hive$(). When the hive is full it harvests it in one go, as if sheared, without angering the bees, and pushes the items down like a hopper.

$(l)Comb mode$() takes the combs. $(l)Honey mode$() fills one glass bottle per harvest instead (the combs are lost). Right-click with bottles to load it (it holds 64); hoppers can feed it from the sides.$(br2)Right-click with an empty hand to switch modes.
